title: Segmented Control with a Flat Thumb and a Badge
description: Segments with $kind="segmented-flat", where the selected segment has a flat surface without the bevel of the default kind, and casts a large shadow that the group clips. A Badge with $layer="success" in a RadioCardSlot with $kind="box" shows a discount with a tinted surface and colored text, and it is part of the name of the option. Use it for a softer look than the raised thumb, such as a choice between billing periods.
